headline: Brent Crude Futures Rebound as Traders Weigh US Election Results and Geopolitics
summary: Brent crude futures traded higher following three sessions of losses. Investors weighed expectations surrounding US midterm election results and potential impacts on Middle East geopolitical tensions.
why: Brent crude serves as the leading international benchmark for global oil pricing.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Oil prices rebounded as traders reassessed political dynamics and conflict risk premiums after three days of declines.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Crude futures recovered from recent declines as market participants evaluated shifting geopolitical risk expectations post-US midterms.
